primary: Hippocrates, Prognostic16, complete chapter, Francis Adams translation
complete_unit_review: The first paragraph relates timing of suppuration to previous fever, rigor and reported weight at a formerly painful location. The second directs turning the patient and asking about the other side, heat and hanging weight while lying on the sound side.
direction_limit: The Adams text assigns empyema to the side opposite the side where weight was felt. A separate English rendering located in The Writings of Hippocrates and Galen describes the affected side as the side in which weight is felt. These formulations may differ in the reference point of felt versus hanging weight; no directional predicate has been fixed.
other_rendering_status: Search excerpt only, not whole edition or Greek collation. Do not claim a demonstrated textual variant.
